jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Our client is an established organization operating within a technically complex product and manufacturing environment.
The organization is seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead key engineering and product development activities while supporting the continued development of the engineering function.
This is a senior leadership opportunity for an individual who combines strong technical expertise with effective people leadership and the ability to work successfully across multiple areas of a business. The successful candidate will play an important role in ensuring engineering programs are effectively prioritized, resourced and delivered while continuing to strengthen the team's capabilities and ways of working.
The Role

The Director of Engineering will lead a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for the development and delivery of new products, product enhancements and technical initiatives.
Working collaboratively across the organization, this individual will provide leadership throughout the development process, from early-stage concepts and feasibility through design, validation, production readiness and launch.
The role requires an engineering leader who can operate effectively across both technical and business environments. The successful candidate will bring sound engineering judgment, strong organizational and people leadership, and the ability to make effective decisions in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for product development and related technical initiatives
Establish clear priorities and ensure engineering activities support broader organizational objectives
Lead technical programs from concept and feasibility through development, validation, production readiness and launch
Support the continued development of engineering capabilities, resources and talent
Recruit, develop and retain strong engineering professionals while creating a collaborative and accountable team environment
Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, standards and development practices
Ensure product designs appropriately consider manufacturing, sourcing, cost, quality and scalability alongside technical requirements
Evaluate engineering programs and make informed decisions regarding priorities, resources, timelines and technical considerations
Work collaboratively with colleagues across manufacturing, operations, supply chain, quality and other functional areas
Support ongoing product and engineering requirements as needed
Identify opportunities to improve engineering effectiveness, execution and consistency
Provide clear recommendations and updates to senior leadership
Build effective relationships across technical and non-technical functions
Support the successful introduction of new and improved products into production
Evaluate existing approaches, identifying opportunities for improvement and creating greater consistency in how engineering programs are planned and delivered.
Establish clear expectations, develop talent and foster an environment of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Balance technical performance with manufacturing considerations, quality, cost, resources and effective execution.
Travel periodically to other locations as required

Requirements

Bachelor's degree required in Engineering; MBA or an advanced technical degree preferred.
12+ years of progressive engineering experience
An experienced engineering leader with a strong technical foundation in a relevant engineering discipline
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams within a technically complex environment
Demonstrated experience managing product development or engineering programs from concept through production or commercialization
Experience within a manufacturing, industrial, engineering or other technically complex product environment
Strong understanding of structured product development methodologies and engineering best practices
Experience developing engineering teams, capabilities, processes and ways of working
Strong understanding of design for manufacturing and the relationship between engineering, cost, quality, sourcing and production requirements
Ability to balance technical considerations with timelines, resources and broader organizational requirements
Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing initiatives and make sound decisions when information may be incomplete
Strong people leadership skills, with experience developing talent and establishing clear expectations
Effective communication skills and the ability to work credibly with senior leaders, technical teams and cross-functional stakeholders
Experience within an established manufacturing, engineering or industrial environment is beneficial
A proactive and accountable leadership style with the ability to take ownership and work effectively across an organization

Benefits

Base range of $200k (commensurate with experience)
This is primarily an on-site leadership position with some flexibility
Periodic business travel will be required
A comprehensive benefits and retirement program is offered
Additional incentive opportunities may form part of the overall compensation package

jobs.title: Director, Engineering (Remote)
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Director of Engineering is a key member of the Life Sciences Operations leadership team, responsible for defining and executing the engineering strategy across multiple manufacturing sites. This role ensures the delivery of scalable, high-quality engineering solutions that enable business growth, operational excellence, and product innovation.

The Director leads cross-functional alignment between Engineering, Operations, R&D, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to translate business priorities into executable plans. This role drives engineering standardization, optimizes resource utilization, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and innovation.

What You’ll Do As a Director Engineering

Enterprise Engineering Leadership

Provide strategic direction and oversight for engineering activities across multiple manufacturing locations, ensuring alignment with business objectives and operational priorities.
Standardize engineering processes and deliverables across engineer-to-order and design-to-order environments.

Strategic Planning & Execution

Develop and execute multi-site engineering strategies, including in-sourcing, product transfers, capacity optimization, and manufacturing footprint initiatives.
Drive alignment of engineering resources to support both current product support and new product development priorities.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with R&D to accelerate new product introductions through effective resource planning and prioritization.
Collaborate with Marketing and Commercial teams to prioritize and execute product lifecycle and sustaining engineering initiatives.
Support Operations leadership in optimizing manufacturing processes, test methods, and production systems.

Program & Portfolio Management

Lead prioritization, execution, and delivery of engineering programs, ensuring adherence to scope, timelines, and cost targets.
Identify risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies, proactively communicating to leadership.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

Champion LEAN methodologies and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, efficiency, and cost performance.
Drive standard work, metrics, and accountability across engineering teams.

Leadership & Talent Development

Build, lead, and develop high-performing engineering teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability.
Provide coaching, performance feedback, and succession planning to strengthen organizational capability.

Financial Management

Own and manage the engineering operating budget (~$5–7M), ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and financial targets.

Required

The Experience, Skills, and Abilities Needed

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Biomedical, Chemical Engineering, or related field
Minimum 10 years of progressive engineering experience within a manufacturing environment
Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing teams or functions
Experience in capital equipment and/or consumable products industries (e.g., medical device, aerospace, defense, industrial equipment)
Demonstrated track record leading engineering strategy across multiple sites or complex operations
Strong program and project management capabilities, including new product introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transfers
Experience with LEAN manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies
Experience evaluating and implementing capital equipment investments

Preferred

Masters in Engineering Discipline, MBA
Experience in more than one of the following functional areas: Operations, Supply Chain, Quality
PMP certification

Other

Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional, matrixed teams at senior levels
Strong business acumen with demonstrated capability to make data-driven decisions
Exceptional communication skills (executive presentations, stakeholder engagement, customer interaction)
Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment
Demonstrated track record of driving operational improvements in quality, cost, and delivery
High level of personal accountability, integrity, and leadership presence

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

Position Overview

We are seeking an Engineering Director - Verification IP
to lead the development of comprehensive verification IP solutions for next-generation interfaces and protocols. You'll be at the forefront of innovation, directing a team that creates industry-leading verification solutions for PCIe Gen5/Gen6, USB3.2, 400Gigabit Ethernet, DDR5, LPDDR5, and coherency protocols like CXL for use with Questa RTL simulation.

This is your opportunity to shape the future of verification technology. Based in Austin, Texas, you'll work with cross-functional teams, field partners, and customers worldwide to deploy and resolve critical verification challenges. You'll combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership to drive product excellence and team growth.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and mentor a high-performing team of verification engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence
Direct the architecture, design, and development of comprehensive verification IP solutions for advanced interfaces and protocols
Collaborate with field engineers and customer teams to understand requirements, deploy solutions, and resolve complex technical issues
Drive technical strategy and roadmap decisions for verification IP products, balancing customer needs with product vision
Ensure quality standards through comprehensive testing, coverage analysis, and continuous improvement of verification methodologies
Partner with cross-functional teams globally to integrate verification solutions with Questa RTL simulation and other Siemens tools

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Computer Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred
18+ years of professional experience in IP/VIP development, verification, or emulation with demonstrated technical leadership
Expert-level proficiency in SystemVerilog and UVM with proven ability to architect and implement complex verification frameworks
Deep hands-on experience with assertions, coverage metrics, test planning, BFM design, debug methodologies, and verification tracking tools
Strong knowledge of at least one standard bus protocol (PCIe, CXL, USB, Ethernet, DDR, or CHI) with understanding of coherent and non-coherent architectures
Proven leadership experience managing technical teams and mentoring engineers

Preferred:

Experience with C/SystemC-based test development and system-level verification
Understanding of CPU, GPU, display, network, and memory subsystems with knowledge of latency, bandwidth, and performance optimization
Experience with emulation platforms and advanced verification methodologies

Why Us?

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. jobs.title: Strategic Engineering Director – Critical Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Strategic Engineering Director – Critical Infrastructure

Location:
Flexible (US-Based) Limited travel
Salary:
Executive Compensation Package + Bonus + Benefits

About the Opportunity

An established organisation delivering complex critical infrastructure programmes is seeking an exceptional Strategic Engineering Director to become the organisation's senior technical authority across major data centre developments.
This is a rare opportunity for an engineering leader who will be recognised as the go-to subject matter expert for complex engineering challenges. Rather than managing day-to-day project delivery, you will provide strategic technical leadership, influence engineering direction, challenge design decisions and serve as the trusted advisor on the most technically demanding programmes.

Operating as an expert across both Electrical and Mechanical you will work across multiple projects simultaneously, you'll support engineering teams from the earliest stages of project development through design, construction, commissioning and operational handover, ensuring engineering solutions remain practical, resilient, scalable and aligned with client objectives.

This role requires someone who is equally comfortable advising executive leadership as they are mentoring engineers, reviewing complex technical solutions and helping project teams overcome their most difficult engineering challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Act as the organisation's recognised subject matter expert for critical engineering systems and complex technical issues.
Provide strategic engineering leadership across multiple high-value infrastructure programmes.
Serve as the senior technical advisor for clients, project teams and executive leadership.
Review, challenge and validate engineering solutions throughout the project lifecycle.
Lead multidisciplinary engineering teams in developing integrated design solutions across all building systems.
Provide expert guidance on electrical distribution, mechanical systems, resilience strategies and critical infrastructure design.
Develop engineering standards, technical guidance and best practices that improve consistency across projects.
Support early-stage planning, technical due diligence and engineering strategy.
Mentor senior engineers and project teams, helping develop technical capability across the wider organisation.
Facilitate technical workshops and engineering reviews to resolve complex design and delivery challenges.
Champion innovation while ensuring engineering solutions remain practical, buildable and commercially viable.
Work closely with clients, consultants, contractors and operational teams to achieve successful project outcomes.

The Candidate

You'll be recognised by colleagues and clients as the individual people seek out when projects encounter technically challenging issues, when critical engineering decisions need to be made, or when an independent technical opinion is required.
Most professionals develop deep expertise in either electrical or mechanical engineering. This opportunity is different. The ideal candidate will bring technical authority in managing complex, multidiscipline Architecture and Engineering (A/E) teams across expansive data center campuses. An individual that will drive industry-leading engineering standards, cultivate client success, and pioneer next-generation integrated facility solutions for hyperscale, colocation, wholesale, and enterprise environments.

You are likely to bring:
More than 20 years of experience delivering technically complex infrastructure or mission-critical facilities.
Significant expertise across both electrical and mechanical building services.
A proven ability to solve complex engineering problems within live, high-risk or technically demanding environments.
Extensive experience providing technical leadership across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Strong knowledge of critical building systems, resilience strategies, commissioning principles and integrated engineering design.
The credibility to influence senior clients, consultants, contractors and executive stakeholders.
Experience developing engineering standards, technical governance and best practice.
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
Professional registration or recognised engineering qualifications would be advantageous.

Experience within data centres, critical infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, healthcare, telecommunications, pharmaceutical or similarly complex environments will all be considered.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to become the technical authority within a respected organisation delivering some of the industry's most complex infrastructure programmes.
You'll shape engineering strategy, influence major project decisions, mentor highly capable engineering teams and become the trusted expert relied upon to solve the challenges others cannot.
If you enjoy being the person everyone turns to when the answer isn't obvious, this role offers an opportunity to make a genuine impact at both project and organisational level.
To register your interest, please contact daniel@cognisantsearch.com

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Director of Engineering is responsible for the overall maintenance and efficient operation of all building systems in a hotel including its mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and HVAC systems. This role ensures that the hotel's facilities are in good working condition, safe for guests and staff, and compliant with local regulations. This includes managing a team of maintenance personnel, overseeing repairs and renovations, and ensuring that the property is compliant with all safety and regulatory standards.

What You'll Be Doing

Maintenance Management:
Plan and execute a preventive maintenance program for all hotel systems, including electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and structural elements.
Conduct regular inspections to identify maintenance needs and prioritize repairs.
Ensure that maintenance tasks are completed promptly and efficiently.
Team Leadership:
Recruit, train, and supervise a team of maintenance staff.
Assign tasks and responsibilities to maintenance personnel.
Provide coaching and mentorship to team members.
Budget Management:
Help in the development of and manage the maintenance department's budget.
Control costs by optimizing maintenance processes and negotiating contracts with vendors and
Safety and Compliance:
Ensure that the hotel complies with all safety codes, regulations, and industry standards.
Oversee regular safety inspections and audits.
Implement emergency response plans and procedures.
Renovations and Projects:
Coordinate and oversee renovation projects within the hotel.
Collaborate with architects, contractors, and suppliers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Record-Keeping:
Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, required inspections, equipment manuals, and warranties.
Generate reports on maintenance and repair expenses for management.
Guest Satisfaction:
Ensure that maintenance issues reported by guests are resolved promptly and effectively.
Implement a guest-focused approach to maintenance to enhance the guest experience.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related field (preferred).
Proven experience in a similar role, preferably in the hospitality industry.
Strong knowledge of building systems, codes, and regulations.
Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
Budgeting and cost control expertise.
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends when needed

Working Conditions & Physical Effort

Physical work is a primary part of many of our hotel and resort jobs. Physical requirements include extended standing and walking, climbing, bending, reaching, pulling, pushing, kneeling, and lifting to 50 lbs. Some work is performed in an interior hotel environment with equipment and machines.

jobs.title: Director of Enterprise Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Western Veterinary Partners (WVP):
Western Veterinary Partners is a mission-driven veterinary support organization headquartered in Denver, Colorado. We acquire, invest in, and support veterinary hospitals throughout the United States.

WVP supports the non-clinical aspects of veterinary hospitals while protecting each hospital’s clinical autonomy, local identity, and community relationships. Our partnership model gives veterinarians access to the operational capabilities and resources of a larger organization without sacrificing the culture that made their practices successful. Our work is guided by our values of integrity, collaboration, alignment, growth, support, and relationships.

Role Overview

Reporting to the SVP of Technology & Enterprise Strategy, the Director of Enterprise Data Engineering
is responsible for establishing the organization’s enterprise architecture practice and building a scalable enterprise data platform that supports business growth, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making. This leader will define the enterprise technology and data platform strategy, oversee the implementation of the enterprise data warehouse, and partner with business and technology leaders to deliver secure, scalable, and integrated solutions.

Working closely with external implementation partners, the Director will provide technical oversight throughout platform development, assume ownership of the production environment following go-live, and establish the architecture and data engineering capabilities needed to support the organization’s long-term technology and analytics strategy.

Candidates located more than 50 miles from the Denver office may work remotely. Candidates based in Denver area are expected to work a hybrid schedule, with two days per week in the office.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture & Technology Strategy

Establish the organization’s Enterprise Architecture function, including governance, standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps.
Develop and maintain enterprise technology strategies that support organizational growth, acquisitions, and digital transformation.
Partner with executive and business leaders to evaluate technology investments and align solutions with business objectives.
Define architectural standards for applications, integrations, cloud platforms, infrastructure, security, and data.
Evaluate emerging technologies and ensure enterprise solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with long-term business needs.

Data Platform & Engineering

Lead the implementation and ongoing evolution of the enterprise data warehouse and data platform.
Develop scalable data integration, modeling, and engineering capabilities that provide trusted, governed data for enterprise reporting, analytics and AI initiatives.
Establish data governance, data quality, and master data management practices to ensure trusted enterprise data.
Ensure the data platform meets performance, scalability, security, and disaster recovery requirements.
Partner with Business Data Analytics Lead and Director of Business Intelligence to deliver prioritized data platform capabilities, integrations, and enterprise data solutions.

Platform Ownership & Delivery

Serve as the technical owner of the enterprise data platform throughout implementation and into production.
Partner with external implementation vendors to review architecture, engineering designs, code quality, and technical deliverables.
Provide technical oversight through design, development, testing, deployment, and production readiness.
Assume ownership of the production environment following go-live, establishing operational support, monitoring, release management, and continuous improvement.
Develop and execute the roadmap for future platform enhancements and new technology capabilities.

Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and mentor the Enterprise Architecture and Data Engineering team.
Establish engineering standards, development practices, and operational processes that promote quality and consistency.
Manage technology vendors, implementation partners, budgets, and strategic technology investments.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.

Required

Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of progressive professional IT experience (exclusive of education), including leadership experience in enterprise architecture, data engineering, enterprise applications, or data platform technologies.
Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise data warehouses and modern data platforms.
Hands-on experience with one or more modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric).
Strong technical expertise in SQL, dbt, Git, data pipeline development and integration, dimensional modeling, semantic modeling, and Power BI.
Experience partnering with third-party implementation vendors and transitioning enterprise platforms into internal operational ownership.
Proven ability to build and lead technical teams, establish governance, and successfully deliver cross-functional technology initiatives.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and executive stakeholder management skills.

This role is not open to receiving agency candidates and any contingent submissions will not be honored.

jobs.description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
Extraordinary co-workers
Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

We are seeking an experienced R&D Senior Manager to lead the Stockpile Engineering & Nuclear Deterrence Product Realization Group (2210). In this pivotal role, you will provide visionary leadership and management across critical Nuclear Deterrence areas, focusing on production realization and sustainment. This group is responsible for leading product realization efforts for the Mk21 Fuze, W76, W88 Alt 370, and Integrated Surety Architecture, along with associated development/sustainment activities such as D5LE2, Building 809 operations, and System Integration leadership across weapon systems. This includes managing key interfaces with Pantex and KCNSC.

Key among the programs anticipated for this group is the leadership of the new HDBT Phase 2 program. Our mission centers on delivering excellence¿ensuring the on-time, safe, and secure delivery of all services and products that support stockpile modernization and sustainment programs. The successful candidate will lead efforts to drive modernization and sustainment activities and successfully deliver all mission-critical objectives.

On any given day, you may be called on to:

Lead managers and staff across multiple technical domains to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of Sandia products and services to diverse programs, while navigating complex challenges and constraints.
Lead direct customer engagement and collaborate closely with peers across the Labs, the broader Nuclear Security Enterprise (NSE), including design and production agencies, NNSA field and production offices, the Department of War (DoW), and other key stakeholders such as the US Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center, US Navy, and Sandia Field Office.
Maintain strong integration with various Sandia organizations to anticipate, prioritize, and resolve current and future product realization and sustainment challenges.
Demonstrate deep understanding of the integrated Group 2210 portfolio and its mission value, develop staff and leadership expertise to meet evolving mission requirements, and continuously enhance organizational health and performance.
Serve as a role model by leading with integrity, building trust-based relationships, challenging the status quo, communicating effectively, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
Champion the development and adoption of innovative methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for projects, programs, and personnel to optimize work scope, schedules, budgets, and organizational objectives.
Guide the group¿s technical efforts and strategic direction in alignment with nuclear deterrence mission priorities and the strategic plans of the Center, Division, and Laboratory.

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must work onsite.

Salary Range

$193,000 - $328,200

Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

Bachelor's and advanced degree (MS or PhD) in engineering or a relevant STEM field.
Ten or more years of relevant experience, including five or more years of management experience.
Active DOE Q clearance or equivalent with the ability to obtain and maintain Sigma 15 access.

Qualifications We Desire

Minimum of 5 years demonstrated leadership and/or managerial experience.
Demonstrated experience in a Systems organization and experience leading product realization activities that required customer engagement.
Leadership experience in nuclear weapon design, production, and/or stockpile stewardship for systems or components with a strong understanding of NSE product delivery and sustainment.
Experience working with Physics DAs, KCNSC, Pantex, NNSA, SFO, USAF and US Navy customers and partners.
Experience executing programs using defined quality processes including the Nuclear Weapon Realize Product Subsystem (RPSS) processes.
Proven commitment to operational excellence in safety, security, quality, and on-time delivery with engineering excellence.
Demonstrated ability to apply and adopt innovative, enterprise-wide approaches to solve complex technical challenges and improve execution.
Self-starter with strategic thinking skills, capable of setting vision and leading organizational change.
Proven ability to build trust-based relationships with external/internal partners and customers.
High social acumen and emotional intelligence; adept at anticipating and resolving ambiguous or contentious issues involving differing technical perspectives.
Skilled at influencing technical decisions and project delivery without direct authority and problem-solving skills in ambiguous environments with limited direction.
Proficient in creating accountability, managing conflict, and facilitating win-win solutions.
Demonstrated passion for shaping and preparing for the future through continuous learning, professional development, and knowledge management.

About Our Team

We lead the Stockpile Management mission with contributions across all phases of the weapon lifecycle. We accomplish our mission by developing and supporting a diverse workforce comprised of technical, operational, and programmatic disciplines that lead and deliver with excellence.

Likewise, the Stockpile Engineering & Nuclear Deterrence Product Realization Group (2210) leads key Nuclear Deterrence product realization and sustainment activities with Systems Engineering and Systems Integration excellence. Systems Integration activities are foundational to the Group¿s role within the ND Portfolio. The group includes a diverse set of programs that spans core sustainment, modernization, and accelerated product realization. Our people are our key asset, as are the strong internal and external relationships we cultivate.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) Q security clearance to start, or equivalent active security clearance with another U.S. government agency (e.g., DOD). Sandia is required by DOE directive to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

Eeo

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements For MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About The Role:

Gusto is building AI agents that help small business owners get work done, whether by working alongside them or by automating their work entirely. AI Platform is the group that builds those agents and the underlying platform they run on, which other teams across Gusto also use to build agents of their own.

We're looking for someone to lead the whole group: an organization of around 25 engineers, together with the managers who run each area. The platform is already in production and running a growing number of agents, so much of the work now is scaling it. That means helping the teams settle into their charters, working out what the shared platform should own versus what product teams build for themselves, and keeping the group's direction aligned with Gusto's broader AI strategy. There is considerable room for the group to grow from here.

About The Team:

AI Platform builds Gusto's agents and the platform they run on, along with the AI features customers use directly. One team owns the shared layer: it connects Gusto's products to the models, runs multi-step agent workflows reliably, and provides the model gateway, the tool and MCP registry, and the evaluation and observability tooling, so that any team can build an agent without recreating the same groundwork each time. It is built on LangGraph and the Vercel AI SDK. The other teams build the customer-facing agents on top of that platform, some working directly with customers and others running in the background to automate work on their behalf.

It's already a highly cross-functional group, with product managers, designers, and data scientists working as part of the team alongside the engineers. It partners with product and AI/ML science teams across the rest of Gusto, and reports to the Head of Engineering, Core Experiences.

Here's What You'll Do Day-to-day:

You'll lead the group's technical strategy for building agents that assist and automate work for small business owners, and ensuring they're built on a platform other teams at Gusto can use.
Set the technical direction and roadmap for the group, including the ongoing question of what the shared platform should own and what product teams build for themselves as more of the company comes to rely on it.
Lead and empower the managers and tech leads in the group, supporting those already in place, hiring ahead of the group's growth, and building strong leadership for each of the teams as they take shape.
Set the engineering standards for how agents behave, treating prompts, tools, and policies as production code and owning the evaluation and guardrail approach that keeps these non-deterministic systems reliable and cost-aware.
Work closely with the product and data science partners in the group, and with the teams across Gusto that build on the platform, so that it meets their needs and becomes the way teams build agents across the company.
Represent AI engineering to senior leadership, and keep the group's work connected to Gusto's broader AI strategy.
Champion AI-native ways of working, and build a team that engineers and managers want to be part of and grow in.

Here's What We're Looking For:

12+ years in engineering, including at least 5 leading through other managers and tech leads. You've grown other leaders and empowered them to run their teams.
A track record of shipping AI or agent products that people rely on, with clear ownership of the engineering behind them. You understand how these systems work in depth: LLM agents, orchestration, tool calling, RAG, and the evaluation and monitoring that keep them dependable.
The ability to set technical strategy across several teams and see it through, including aligning teams you don't directly manage around shared outcomes.
Enough technical depth to engage senior engineers on a difficult architecture decision, without needing to write the code yourself.
Experience growing an engineering organization, ideally somewhere that was still finding its shape.
You treat reliability, evaluation, and guardrails as core engineering work rather than a step left to the end.
Comfort leading a cross-functional group, working closely with product managers, designers, and data scientists as much as with engineers.
You develop and empower other leaders, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and work well across many teams.

It's a plus if you've worked across both platform and product engineering, built with a framework like LangGraph or the Vercel AI SDK, or have led in fintech or another regulated environment.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $274,000 to $305,000 in Denver and most remote locations, and $321,000 to $356,000 for San Francisco, New York, and Seattle. Annual cash incentives and Stock equity is additional. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience, level, and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). jobs.title: Deputy Head of Production, Autonomous Airpower (Fury)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are looking for a Deputy Head of Production, Autonomous Airpower (Fury) to join our rapidly growing team at Arsenal 1, our cutting edge factory in Asheville, OH. As the Deputy Head of Production, you will work directly on our autonomous fighter jet, Fury. You will have the ability to have your fingerprints all over something that was just science fiction until now. You will own the short-to-mid-term strategy and execution for the manufacture of Fury. You will lead and collaborate with some of the most brilliant engineers and manufacturing talent in the world.

What You'll Do

Own production outcomes for Fury, standing up new manufacturing lines, including ramp plans, and people management.
Create and execute a long-term strategy to rapidly scale production volumes from a prototype units per year to predictable production rates.
Lead cross-functional production teams to execute plans that meet aggressive customer timelines.
Partner with engineering to transition new designs and systems to production quickly and efficiently.
Shape corporate tools and processes to support the unique needs of aerospace production.
Triage production resources and focus to manage shifting priorities in a dynamic environment.
Serve as a rallying point for production teams through strong leadership, advocacy, and on-site presence.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of experience overseeing the production and test of complex electromechanical products.
Ownership and successful execution of NPI for multiple complex hardware products.
Strong leadership of large (100+ person) manufacturing teams.
Experience directing and leading large cross functional teams across planning, supply chain, engineering, quality, and production teams to deliver products of the highest quality.
A strong background in quality assurance, with a track record of driving a "quality-first" culture in a production environment.
Past success operating in low rate and high rate manufacturing environments.
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.
High ownership and ability to effectively manage multiple (6+) large projects and priorities in parallel, at a rapid pace, and report out on progress regularly.
Ability to work onsite five days a week at our Asheville, OH campus (Arsenal 1).

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of experience overseeing the production of highly complex aerospace products.
Success scaling production operations by 5x or more in a high-complexity manufacturing environment.
Ownership and successful execution of NPI for multiple complex hardware products in the aerospace or hard tech.
Deep experience with the niche supply chains for aerospace and robotics.
Experience managing and operating in highly secure manufacturing environments.

US Salary Range

$190,000—$252,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/14/2026

Meet the Team

Cisco’s Cloud Security organization is at the forefront of securing the modern workforce, protecting users, data, and applications wherever they reside. As the cornerstone of Cisco’s Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) strategy, we deliver cloud-native protection for users, data, and application no matter where they reside.

Cisco’s Cloud Security team is looking for a Director of Software Engineering to lead an engineering team working on our market-leading Security Service Edge (SSE) products. In this role, you will drive the strategy, execution, and delivery of multiple management/control plane services of Cisco secure Access including policy and access control, cloud control plane and service reliability, behavior analytics and security data platform, AI enabled assistant and intelligent automation, and similar services.

You will lead multiple engineering teams building scalable, high-performance systems that protect millions of users around the world as they access the internet and cloud applications. This is a pivotal leadership role that requires strong technical depth, cloud platform expertise, and the ability to implement at scale in a fast-paced environment.

Your Impact

As The Director Of Software Engineering, You Will

Lead and Inspire: Manage and mentor a high-performing engineering teams responsible for full development cycle of multiple management/ control plane services.
Strategic Direction: Set technical direction and vision for cloud security services, collaborating with Product Management, UX, and Security stakeholders to deliver innovative, scalable, and secure solutions.
Execution Excellence: Drive end-to-end software development, from design through deployment, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
Team Development: Attract, hire, and retain top engineering talent; foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and diversity.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with architecture, operations, and customer success teams to ensure seamless integration, high reliability, and outstanding user experience.
Continuous Improvement: Champion process and technology improvements, leveraging metrics and customer feedback to optimize products and engineering practices.

Minimum Qualifications

15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience leading managers and global teams.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure), distributed systems, micro service architecture, multi-tenant services or similar data platforms, AI/ML systems, and observability, record delivering enterprise cloud software or SaaS platforms with demanding availability, scale, security, and data-consistency requirements.
Experience with modern software development practices, including CI/CD and DevOps, with experience building agentic systems and employing AI to improve productivity across the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with security platforms, zero trust, SSE/SASE, ZTNA, SWG, CASB, DLP, FWaaS, DNS security, browser isolation, or digital experience monitoring.
Experience with policy distribution, routing, identity-aware access, security telemetry, audit/event history, behavioral analytics, and event-driven data platforms.
Expertise in full stack development with experience in React, python, go, java.
Familiarity with regulated enterprise or public-sector environments and security/compliance programs such as FedRAMP.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Augmodo uses Spatial AI to bridge the gap between spatial computing and retail to redefine physical commerce for the AI era. As Head of Engineering, you will be responsible for building and scaling the technical foundation of Augmodo. You will lead a team of world-class engineers in developing real-time AI-driven spatial computing applications that seamlessly integrate with the physical world.

Role Overview

As the Head of Engineering at Augmodo, you will serve as a cornerstone of our leadership team, responsible for nurturing the talent and technical excellence that drive our mission forward. We are looking for a seasoned people leader who understands that world-class spatial computing is built by world-class teams. Your primary focus will be to champion our engineering culture—mentoring a multi-disciplinary group of experts across CV, hardware, and cloud, and providing them with the clarity and support needed to solve the challenges of physical commerce.

In this role, you will balance high-level technical strategy with a deep commitment to organizational health. You will act as a bridge between our ambitious product vision and the day-to-day execution of your team, ensuring that as we scale our technology, we are also scaling our people, processes, and collaborative spirit. We aren't just looking for a technical expert; we are looking for a dedicated leader who takes pride in building a resilient, high-performing engineering organization where innovation and people thrive in equal measure.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and manage a multi-disciplinary engineering team spanning computer vision, backend, frontend, hardware, and firmware.
Define and execute the engineering roadmap, balancing innovation with scalability.
Architect and build real-time, AI-driven spatial computing applications.
Collaborate closely with product, business, and operation teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Oversee the development and delivery of new features and products, ensuring they meet quality standards and customer expectations.
Ensure the scalability, security, and reliability of Augmodo’s platform.
Stay at the forefront of spatial AI, computer vision, and real-time data processing.
Own technical decision-making, from infrastructure to ML model deployment.
Cultivate a culture of innovation, rapid iteration, and continuous improvement.

Experience & Qualifications

Master's in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
At Collective Health, we’re transforming how employers and their people engage with their health benefits by seamlessly integrating cutting-edge technology, compassionate service, and world-class user experience design.
Role Overview Collective Health is transforming healthcare for millions who use our platform to understand, navigate, and pay for care. The Member Experience Engineering team builds every interface a member or Member Advocate interacts with: our web and mobile apps, plus the tools and AI powering our contact center.
We are hiring a Senior
  Director of Member Experience Engineering
to lead this organization. You will own the engineering strategy and execution across three connected domains:
Member digital experience

— the member web portal and mobile apps, including care navigation, secure messaging, benefits and claims views, and the notification systems that keep members informed.
Member Advocate tooling

— the internal application suite our advocates use to serve members, plus the platforms that make advocates faster and more accurate.
Contact center experience (our biggest opportunity)

— the AI, automation, and platform work that reduces call volume, deflects and resolves inquiries earlier, and makes every advocate interaction better. This includes our Contact-Center-as-a-Service (CCaaS) platform, Agent Assist, virtual assistants, IVR automation, and conversational analytics.

The main focus of the role is using AI to lower the cost and raise the quality of member support
— deflecting avoidable contacts, resolving inquiries in self-service, and giving advocates real-time, accurate answers when a human is the right channel.
What you'll do Set the strategy

for member experience engineering across web, mobile, advocate tooling, and the contact center — and translate it into a roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes (cost-to-serve, contact reduction, member and advocate satisfaction).
Lead the AI agenda for the contact center.

Drive the roadmap for Agent Assist , Smart Search, virtual assistants, IVR automation, and contact-deflection features. Push for real, defensible reductions in call demand and average handle time — not demos.
Own the call-center technology platform

, including our CCaaS migration and the integrations that connect telephony, chat, and digital channels into one member journey.
Own conversational and contact analytics

— topic tagging, quality monitoring at scale, and the reporting that tells us what members are calling about and which contacts we can prevent. Ensure this data actually steers the roadmap.
Deliver the member-facing digital experience

on web and mobile, meeting client and regulatory commitments (access controls, dependent access, SSO, privacy) on committed timelines.
Own the advocate tooling suite

— the internal applications that determine how efficiently and accurately advocates serve members.
Partner deeply

with our Customer Experience, Product and Design teams to build quality products for our members and member advocates
Build and grow the team

— hire, mentor, and develop engineering managers and senior engineers; set the bar for technical quality, security, and reliability in a HIPAA-regulated, PHI-handling environment.
Report up and out.

Communicate strategy, trade-offs, and results to executive leadership and represent engineering in cross-functional and client-facing forums.

To be successful in this role, you'll need: 15+ years

in software engineering with 5+ years leading engineering teams
, including managing managers.
Proven ownership of large-scale, member- or customer-facing web and mobile products
.
Contact center / customer support technology experience

— hands-on familiarity with CCaaS platforms, telephony/IVR, agent-assist tooling, and support-operations metrics (contact volume, deflection rate, average handle time, first-contact resolution, cost-to-serve, quality/CSAT).
Applied AI/ML fluency

, especially using LLMs / GenAI to reduce support demand: knowledge of Retrieval-Augmentented Generation (RAG), intent detection, conversational analytics, and automated quality monitoring. You know how to evaluate accuracy, manage hallucination risk, and measure whether an AI investment actually moved the metric.
Strong track record turning operational metrics into an engineering roadmap
and defending trade-offs to executives.
Excellent cross-functional leadership
across product, operations, design, data/insights, and external vendors.
Comfort operating in a regulated, data-sensitive domain
(healthcare/HIPAA a strong plus) where security and privacy are non-negotiable.

Nice to have:
Healthcare, health-benefits, insurance, or other regulated-industry experience.
Experience running a vendor selection and migration
for a major contact-center or AI platform.
Background scaling both customer-facing product engineering
and internal operational tooling
in the same org.

In addition to the salary, you will be eligible for 1,000,000 stock options and benefits like health insurance, 401k, and paid time off . jobs.description:
Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

This job is responsible for building and leading a team to deliver technology products and services that meet business outcomes. Key responsibilities include developing a technology strategy, ensuring technology solutions comply with applicable standards, promoting design, engineering, and organizational practices, and advocating and advancing modern, Agile solution delivery practices. Job expectations may include coaching, mentoring, providing feedback and hands on career development, identifying emerging talent, fostering leadership skills, and managing stakeholders.

Overview:

The Senior Engineering Manager – Patch & Repave Platform will lead the design, architecture, and delivery of a new enterprise solution that enables automated patching of deployed compute infrastructure and repaving of strategic immutable container and VM offerings. This role builds and leads a high-performing engineering team responsible for delivering a secure, scalable, policy-driven platform that modernizes patching practices, reduces vulnerability exposure, and improves reliability through immutable infrastructure patterns.

This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of platform engineering, security, SRE/operations, and developer experience, requiring strong execution, technical depth, and stakeholder alignment across a complex enterprise environment.

Responsibilities:

Builds and manages teams by performing financial activities to inform workforce strategy and hiring practices, setting and tracking maturity and quality objectives, and training employees/teams to address feedback and achieve quality and performance objectives
Facilitates performance and career development of employees/teams through performance reviews, coaching, and creating development plans that are needed to build competencies and skills
Manages solution delivery and application performance in production (app health, resiliency, performance, security, enterprise data management standards, audit exams and reviews), ensuring all relevant risk, financial, and compliance policies are met
Manages relationships with business and technology partners and leads and creates followership in Communities of Practice in the organization
Contributes to the technology strategy for their technical domain
Creates an inclusive and healthy working environment and helps to resolve organizational impediments/blockers
Ensures that execution is aligned with product strategy by working with product management and other stakeholders

Managerial Responsibilities:

This position may also have responsibilities for managing associates. At Bank of America, all managers at this level demonstrate the following responsibilities, in addition to those specific to the role, listed above.

Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Models an inclusive environment for employees and clients, aligned to company Great Place to Work goals.
Manager of Process & Data: Demonstrates deep process knowledge, operational excellence and innovation through a focus on simplicity, data based decision making and continuous improvement.
Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Communicates enterprise decisions, purpose, and results, and connects to team strategy, priorities and contributions.
Risk Manager: Ensures proper risk discipline, controls and culture are in place to identify, escalate and debate issues.
People Manager & Coach: Provides inspection, coaching and feedback to motivate, differentiate and improve performance.
Financial Steward: Actively manages expenses and budgets in alignment with objectives, making sound financial decisions.
Enterprise Talent Leader: Assesses talent and builds bench strength for roles across the organization.
Driver of Business Outcomes: Delivers results by effectively prioritizing, inspecting and appropriately delegating team work.

Required Qualifications:

8–12+ years in software/platform engineering with 8+ years leading engineering teams (hiring, performance, delivery accountability)
Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale platforms (internal developer platforms, infra automation, lifecycle management systems)
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture and distributed systems fundamentals (reliability, scalability, fault tolerance)
Demonstrated experience with CI/CD, release engineering, and automated quality gates (test automation, progressive delivery patterns)
Working knowledge of immutable infrastructure concepts (golden images, artifact promotion, replace vs. mutate) and/or platform lifecycle automation
Hands-on familiarity with modern infrastructure ecosystems:
Containers/Kubernetes and/or VM platforms
Technologies:
React/Angular - Java Core - MongoDB/REDIS

Infrastructure as Code and configuration management approaches
Observability (metrics/logs/tracing) and operational tooling
Strong collaboration skills across Security, SRE, Infrastructure, and Application stakeholders; ability to align diverse requirements into a coherent roadmap
Excellent communication—can translate between executive outcomes, product requirements, and engineering delivery

Desired Qualifications:

Experience building patch orchestration systems, vulnerability remediation automation, or compliance reporting platforms
Experience operating platforms with SLOs and partnering with SRE on operational readiness and on-call rotations
Familiarity with:
Image pipelines (Packer-like approaches), artifact registries, and supply-chain security patterns
Progressive delivery tooling and safe rollout strategies (rings/canaries/blue-green)
Experience with hybrid/on-prem environments in addition to public cloud
Familiarity with event-driven architecture (pub/sub), streaming, or change-data-capture patterns for maintaining metadata freshness.
Experience with UX-heavy internal products and partnering with design teams to deliver polished workflow experiences.
Strong background in platform security and compliance automation (audit trails, policy-as-code concepts, evidence generation).
Experience building scalable and reliable Tier 1 systems

Stakeholder Management
Technical Strategy Development
Analytical Thinking
Application Development
Collaboration
Result Orientation
Solution Delivery Process
Agile Practices
Architecture
Automation
Data Management
DevOps Practices

1st shift (United States of America)

40

Assistant Director for Election Technology, Division of Elections

Tennessee Department of State
Division of Elections

Mission:
The mission of the Office of the Secretary of State is to exceed the expectations of our customers, the taxpayers, by operating at the highest levels of accuracy, cost-effectiveness, and accountability in a customer-centered environment.

Supervisor:
Coordinator of Elections

Summary:
Serves as the Division of Elections' technology manager and advisor, who works in coordination with the Tennessee Secretary of State’s IT Division and is responsible for statewide election technology strategy, cybersecurity, state voter registration data, election reporting systems, business continuity planning, technology procurement, and oversight of election technology support provided to Tennessee's 95 county election commissions.

This position coordinates technology projects, monitors system performance, supports election security efforts, and serves as a liaison between the Division of Elections, state IT personnel, county election officials, and technology vendors. The position helps ensure election technology systems remain secure, dependable, and compliant with applicable state and federal requirements. The Assistant Director supervises two employees.

Key Responsibilities:

Technology Leadership
Assist in planning and implementing the Election Division's technology strategy.
Coordinate the day-to-day operation of all state election technology systems and applications.
Recommend improvements to enterprise technology standards and governance policies.
Support technology modernization initiatives.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management
Coordinate with CISA, DHS, FBI, TBI, and other security partners.
Support the development and maintenance of cybersecurity policies and incident response plans.
Participate in risk assessments and security reviews.
